listeningStage3Data.title: The Big Soccer Game (大滿貫足球賽)

articleContent.en: Sam wants to beat the other team in the soccer game.
articleContent.zh: 山姆想在足球比賽中打敗另一隊。

articleContent.en: His friends offer their support and come to watch him play.
articleContent.zh: 他的朋友提供支持並前來看他比賽。

articleContent.en: During the game, Sam needs to focus on the ball.
articleContent.zh: 在比賽期間，山姆需要專注於球上。

articleContent.en: Even when the game is hard, he decides not to give up.
articleContent.zh: 即使比賽很艱難，他決定不放棄。

articleContent.en: Finally, Sam scores a goal and helps his team win.
articleContent.zh: 最後，山姆踢進一球並幫助他的球隊獲勝。

articleContent.en: He feels happy because he can achieve his dream today.
articleContent.zh: 他感到很高興，因為他今天能夠實現他的夢想。

listeningStage3Data.title: A Safe Flight to Tokyo (前往東京的安全飛行)

articleContent.en: Mrs. Brown is a passenger on a flight to Tokyo today.
articleContent.zh: 布朗太太今天是飛往東京班機上的一位乘客。

articleContent.en: She was absent from work last week to prepare for this trip.
articleContent.zh: 她上週請假沒上班，以準備這次旅行。

articleContent.en: Some people are afraid the plane might crash, but the pilot is very careful.
articleContent.zh: 有些人害怕飛機會墜毀，但機師非常小心。

articleContent.en: Before landing, she receives a nice hot meal from the flight attendant.
articleContent.zh: 在降落前，她收到空服員送來的美味熱餐。

articleContent.en: After landing, she uses cash to buy a beautiful souvenir.
articleContent.zh: 降落後，她使用現金買了一個美麗的紀念品。

articleContent.en: She thinks this special trip is definitely worth all the money.
articleContent.zh: 她認為這次特別的旅行絕對值得所有的錢。

questions.question: Who is a passenger on the plane today?
Why was Mrs. Brown absent from work last week?
What does Mrs. Brown receive before landing?
What does she use to buy a souvenir after landing?
Where is Mrs. Brown flying to?
How does she feel about her trip?
options: It is worth all the money
questions.correct: It is worth all the money

articleContent.en: Grandfather loves working in the community garden every weekend.
articleContent.zh: 祖父喜歡每個週末在社區花園裡工作。

articleContent.en: He needs rich soil and plenty of water for his plants.
articleContent.zh: 他的植物需要肥沃的土壤和充足的水分。

articleContent.en: The neighbors offer to help him water the flowers.
articleContent.zh: 鄰居們主動幫他給花朵澆水。

articleContent.en: They also supply new seeds to make the garden beautiful.
articleContent.zh: 他們還提供新種子讓花園變得美麗。

articleContent.en: Grandfather works hard and receives many fresh tomatoes in summer.
articleContent.zh: 祖父努力工作，在夏天收穫了許多新鮮的番茄。

articleContent.en: He gives them away to show his support to his friends.
articleContent.zh: 他把番茄送給大家，以向朋友們表達支持。

readingStage3Data.title: The Tortoise and the Hare (伊索寓言：龜兔賽跑)

articleContent.en: A fast hare always liked to say that he could beat any animal in a race.
articleContent.zh: 一隻快速的野兔總是喜歡說他可以在比賽中打敗任何動物。

articleContent.en: A slow tortoise challenged him to a run.
articleContent.zh: 一隻慢吞吞的烏龜向他挑戰跑步。

articleContent.en: During the race, the hare was confident and decided to rest, while the tortoise chose to focus on running slowly.
articleContent.zh: 在比賽期間，野兔很有自信並決定休息，而烏龜則選擇專注於慢慢向前跑。

articleContent.en: The tortoise did not give up and won the race in the end.
articleContent.zh: 烏龜沒有放棄，最後贏得了比賽。

articleContent.en: This famous story teaches us that slow and steady wins the race.
articleContent.zh: 這個著名的故事教導我們，持續努力最終會獲得勝利。

What did the hare say he could do?
options: Beat any animal in a race
questions.correct: Beat any animal in a race

questions.question: What did the hare decide to do during the race?
What did the tortoise focus on during the race?
Who won the race in the end?

options: Slow and steady wins the race
questions.correct: Slow and steady wins the race

readingStage3Data.title: Jack and the Beanstalk (經典童話：傑克與魔豆)

articleContent.en: Jack and his mother were very poor and had no cash to buy food.
articleContent.zh: 傑克和他的母親非常貧窮，沒有現金買食物。

articleContent.en: One day, a strange man made an offer to trade magic beans for Jack's cow.
articleContent.zh: 有一天，一個陌生人提議用魔豆交換傑克的牛。

articleContent.en: When Jack brought the beans home, his angry mother threw them out into the rich garden soil.
articleContent.zh: 當傑克把豆子帶回家時，他生氣的母親把它們扔到了花園土壤裡。

articleContent.en: The next morning, a huge beanstalk grew high into the sky.
articleContent.zh: 第二天早上，一株巨大的豆莖長高聳入了天空。

articleContent.en: Jack climbed it and found a magical giant's castle above the clouds.
articleContent.zh: 傑克爬上了豆莖，在雲端上方發現了一個神奇的巨人城堡。

articleContent.en: He received a golden hen and knew the brave adventure was completely worth it.
articleContent.zh: 他收到了一隻金雞，並知道這場勇敢的冒險完全是值得的。

questions.question: Why were Jack and his mother in trouble at first?
options: They had no cash for food
They were lost in a forest
questions.correct: They had no cash for food

questions.question: What did the strange man offer to Jack?
Where did Jack's mother throw the magic beans?
What grew in the garden the next morning?
What did Jack find above the clouds?

readingStage3Data.title: Green Flying and the Future (環保新知：綠色飛行與未來)

articleContent.en: Airplanes emit carbon, so engineers work hard to protect our air.
articleContent.zh: 飛機會排放碳，所以工程師們努力工作以保護我們的空氣。

articleContent.en: Every year, millions of people travel as a passenger on international flights.
articleContent.zh: 每年有數百萬人作為乘客搭乘國際航班旅行。

articleContent.en: Scientists want to supply cleaner energy to airlines to reduce pollution.
articleContent.zh: 科學家們想要向航空公司供給更清潔的能源以減少污染。

articleContent.en: Many eco-friendly organizations offer full support to build electric planes in the future.
articleContent.zh: 許多環保組織提供全力支持，以在未來製造電動飛機。

articleContent.en: With new technology, safer planes will fly without causing environmental harm.
articleContent.zh: 有了新科技，更安全的飛機將在不造成環境傷害的情況下飛行。

articleContent.en: If everyone works together, we can achieve a zero-emission future for air travel.
articleContent.zh: 如果大家共同努力，我們就能實現空中交通零排放的未來。
